papers.title: World Embedding Benchmark
papers.abstract: Physical fidelity has received increasing attention in world models and video generation, yet how video representations encode physical information remains less understood. We introduce the World Embedding Benchmark, comprising 8,000 controlled simulation cases from 80 families spanning fluid mechanics, solid mechanics, dynamics, and optics & electromagnetism. Each case pairs a rendered video with simulation-derived physical annotations, supporting three complementary tasks: text-video retrieval, physical-property regression, and multiple-choice video-description pair classification. We use these tasks to distinguish cross-modal physical alignment from the recoverability of quantitative physical information. Evaluated pre-trained omnimodal embedding models show weak retrieval and near-chance within-family pair classification, while lightweight probes recover useful physical information from frozen video embeddings. Continual contrastive training with physics-specific video-text pairs improves retrieval and pair classification but degrades physical-property regression, revealing a trade-off between alignment and quantitative information recoverability. Finally, we use the embeddings to retrieve reference videos for retrieval-augmented generation with MiniMax-H3. Retrieved references improve the physical fidelity of generated videos, with stronger retrieval models yielding larger gains in our experiments. Together, these findings highlight the need to evaluate physical alignment and property recoverability jointly, and demonstrate the utility of physical representations for improving video generation.

ai_summary.problem: 世界模型和视频生成中的物理保真度日益受关注，但视频表示如何编码物理信息仍缺乏系统理解与评测。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 World Embedding Benchmark，包含 80 个家族、8,000 个受控仿真案例，覆盖流体力学、固体力学、动力学及光学与电磁学，每个案例配渲染视频与仿真物理标注；设计文本-视频检索、物理属性回归、视频-描述对多选分类三项任务，并评测预训练全模态嵌入模型、轻量探针、持续对比训练及基于 MiniMax-H3 的检索增强生成。
ai_summary.result: 预训练全模态嵌入模型检索弱、同家族视频-描述对分类接近随机，但轻量探针可从冻结视频嵌入中恢复有用物理信息；持续对比训练提升检索与配对分类却降低物理属性回归，揭示对齐与定量信息可恢复性之间的权衡；检索到的参考视频能提升生成视频物理保真度，且检索模型越强增益越大。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次提出联合评估跨模态物理对齐与定量物理属性可恢复性的世界嵌入基准，并展示物理表示可用于检索增强视频生成以提升物理保真度。
ai_summary.relevance: 为世界模型、视频生成和多模态表示学习提供了物理理解评测基准，并指出物理表示对提升生成物理保真度的实用价值。
ai_summary.org: 作者机构未在提供信息中列出；摘要中提及 MiniMax-H3。

papers.title: DEPICT: Scoring Text-to-Image Alignment by Answer Agreement
papers.abstract: Image-text alignment is a core problem in computer vision with applications in caption evaluation, hallucination detection, data curation, and the benchmarking of text-to-image (T2I) generators. As T2I models improve, benchmarking has become demanding, requiring metrics capable of finding a series of issues like missing objects, swapped attributes, miscounts, and ignored negations. Recent work addresses this by fine-tuning evaluators on preference data or by prompting a vision-language model, either holistically with the caption or with decomposed verification questions. However, existing approaches fall short: fine-tuned metrics remain bound to one backbone and training distribution; holistic metrics miss fine-grained details; and decomposed metrics rely on a fixed-YES assumption that penalizes faithful images whenever that assumption fails. In contrast, we propose DEPICT, a training-free metric that replaces fixed reference answers with expected agreement between image-based and caption-only answers, weighting questions by how decisively the caption determines them. By replacing fixed references, our agreement rule increases negation accuracy from 19% to 88%. To recover the context lost during decomposition, DEPICT merges this agreement score with a holistic score. We evaluate DEPICT on five benchmarks and eleven backbones from three model families and find that it surpasses all training-free metrics and exceeds fine-tuned evaluators on two out of three human-correlation benchmarks.

ai_summary.problem: 现有图文对齐评测方法存在局限：微调指标受限于特定骨干和训练分布，整体式指标忽略细粒度细节，分解式指标依赖固定“是”答案，从而在假设失败时惩罚忠实图像。
ai_summary.method: 提出DEPICT，一种免训练指标，用图像答案与仅文本答案之间的期望一致性替代固定参考答案，并按描述对问题的决定性加权；再将该一致性分数与整体评分融合，以恢复分解时丢失的上下文。
ai_summary.result: 在5个基准、3个模型家族的11个骨干上评估，DEPICT超越所有免训练指标，并在3个人工相关性基准中的2个上超过微调评估器；否定准确率从19%提升到88%。
ai_summary.novelty: 用图像与文本答案间的期望一致性替代固定参考答案，并融合整体分数，实现免训练且细粒度的图文对齐评分。
ai_summary.relevance: 为T2I生成、描述评估、幻觉检测和数据筛选提供更稳健、通用且可解释的对齐度量。
ai_summary.org: 提供信息中未给出作者机构；从作者背景推测可能涉及葡萄牙NOVA大学与Unbabel等。

papers.title: MobiAgent: Dual-Loop Recursive Policy Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon mobile manipulation presents significant challenges due to compounding execution errors and capacity interference between locomotion and arm control. While recent Vision-Language-Action models excel at short-horizon tasks, they lack the hierarchical reasoning required for multi-stage objectives. Furthermore, existing hierarchical agents suffer from rigid sub-task mapping, inflexible replanning, and a lack of continuous learning. To address these limitations, we introduce MobiAgent, a dual-loop agentic framework that bridges robust deployment execution and recursive policy self-improvement. During deployment, the Inner Loop decouples high-level reasoning from low-level control through highly composable atomic skills. It employs Vision-Language models for receding-horizon planning and visual reflection, dynamically composing skills to ensure robust error recovery. These skills are executed by specialized flow-matching experts that share a unified VLM backbone, maximizing reusability while mitigating capacity interference. Concurrently, the Outer Loop drives automated lifelong learning by autonomously segmenting and verifying deployment rollouts, clustering them to discover atomic skills, and continuously fine-tuning the skill library without human annotations. Evaluations on RoboCasa, BEHAVIOR-1K, and real-world tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of MobiAgent. It outperforms $π_{0.5}$-TA by 22.5 percentage points on BEHAVIOR-1K and enables robust recovery from execution failures. Through autonomous data recycling, success improves from 7.50% to 27.50% on RoboCasa and from 32.5% to 57.5% on Astribot S1.

ai_summary.problem: 长时程移动操作任务中，移动与臂控之间存在能力干扰、执行误差累积，而现有VLA模型缺乏多阶段目标所需的分层推理能力，已有分层Agent又存在子任务映射僵化、重规划不灵活、无法持续学习的问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出MobiAgent双环智能体框架：内环用VLM进行滚动时域规划与视觉反思，动态组合高度可复用的原子技能，由共享统一VLM主干的流匹配专家执行，实现高层推理与底层控制的解耦；外环通过自动切分与验证部署轨迹、聚类发现原子技能并持续微调技能库，实现无需人工标注的终身学习。
ai_summary.result: 在RoboCasa、BEHAVIOR-1K及真实任务上验证有效：BEHAVIOR-1K上比π0.5-TA高出22.5个百分点，并能从执行失败中稳健恢复；借助自主数据回收，RoboCasa成功率从7.50%提升到27.50%，Astribot S1上从32.5%提升到57.5%。
ai_summary.novelty: 将可组合原子技能的内环部署执行与自动化轨迹回收驱动的外环终身学习结合，形成无需人工标注的递归式策略自改进闭环。
ai_summary.relevance: 为长时程具身智能体提供了可扩展的分层规划与自进化范式，降低了对人工标注数据的依赖，推动移动操作从短时程技能走向持续学习。
ai_summary.org: 提供的作者信息中机构字段为空，无法确认具体机构；实验在Astribot S1平台上进行。

papers.title: ReFract: Benchmarking Perspective Awareness in Language Model Agents with Text World Models
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings such as industrial maintenance and equipment fault troubleshooting, where workers occupy a variety of roles. A capable agent must therefore act in a way that is calibrated to user's role: taking actions and providing information that respect the role's knowledge and capability boundaries. Unlike coding, where mistakes are usually recoverable, agent responses in these settings are enacted on physical equipment, and can therefore cause irreversible equipment damage, production loss, or personnel harm. Existing benchmarks, however, largely overlook the need for agents to infer what a role intends and acting only through tools that role may legitimately use, a capability which we term Perspective Awareness. To this end, we introduce ReFract, a benchmark of 150 expert-validated entries in which an agent must act differently in response to the same query depending on user's role. Entries of ReFract are grounded in anonymized queries from domain support conversations, against which we construct Text World Models that simulate the agent's operating environments and assemble perspective-aware action trajectories. State-of-the-art LLMs solve at most 69% of the tasks with more than 50% of their trajectories contain attempts of taking perspective-violating actions. ReFract exposes perspective awareness as a distinct, largely unsolved axis of agent evaluation and motivates agents that calibrate not just how to act, but for whom.

ai_summary.problem: 在高风险的工业维护和故障排查场景中，LLM Agent 需要根据用户角色调整行动与信息，尊重其知识与能力边界；但现有基准大多忽视了这种“视角感知”能力。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 ReFract 基准，包含 150 条经专家验证的条目，来源于匿名化领域支持对话；并为每条查询构建 Text World Models，模拟 Agent 操作环境并组装视角感知的动作轨迹，使同一查询因用户角色不同而要求不同行动。
ai_summary.result: 当前最先进 LLM 最多只能解决 69% 的任务，且超过 50% 的轨迹包含违反用户角色边界的动作尝试，表明视角感知仍是 Agent 评估中一个独立且远未解决的问题。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统性地提出并评测语言模型 Agent 的“视角感知”能力，即不仅决定如何行动，还要判断为谁行动。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动 Agent 评估从通用任务完成能力扩展到角色校准与安全边界，对高风险工业和具身智能场景中的可信部署具有重要意义。

papers.title: AVL-JEPA: Preventing Causal Dynamics Information Collapse In Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture World Models
papers.abstract: Joint embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) predict future latent representations without reconstructing observations, enabling world models to focus on high-level semantic dynamics. However, a JEPA can preserve high dimensional visual information while discarding information about the physical consequences of actions. We call this failure mode causal dynamics information collapse and propose action-grounded vision-invariance latent (AVL) to prevent this collapse. We first use the executed action as an auxiliary dynamics anchor that encourages the model to preserve dynamics information, and then use a vision-invariance pathway which aligns perturbed and clean latent predictions without discarding dynamics information, forcing the model to fully understand and utilize causal dynamics information. We validate AVL on four robotic control tasks (TwoRoom, PushT, OGBench Cube, and Reacher), showing that it substantially improves success rates under visual perturbations while preserving clean-environment performance. We further evaluate physical consequence alignment, clean-noisy dynamics consistency, and the causal effect of targeted transition subspace erasure. Collectively, these results indicate that dynamic information causally relevant to planning is preserved from collapse under AVL.

ai_summary.problem: JEPA 世界模型在预测未来潜表示时，可能保留高维视觉信息却丢弃动作导致的物理后果信息，论文将这种失败模式称为因果动态信息坍缩。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出动作锚定视觉不变潜表示（AVL）：先用已执行动作作为辅助动态锚点，鼓励模型保留动态信息；再通过视觉不变路径对齐扰动与干净潜预测，在不丢弃动态信息的前提下迫使模型理解并利用因果动态信息。
ai_summary.result: 在 TwoRoom、PushT、OGBench Cube、Reacher 四个机器人控制任务上，AVL 在视觉扰动下显著提升成功率，同时保持干净环境性能；进一步实验表明其能对齐物理后果、保持干净-噪声动态一致性，并验证目标转移子空间擦除的因果效应。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出 AVL 方法防止 JEPA 世界模型中的因果动态信息坍缩，通过动作锚定与视觉不变路径兼顾动态信息保留和视觉鲁棒性。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作有助于提升面向规划与控制的世界模型在视觉扰动下的鲁棒性，对具身智能和基于 JEPA 的世界模型研究具有参考价值。

papers.title: HyperBrowseComp: A Multilingual and Multimodal Stress Test for Web-Browsing Agents
papers.abstract: We introduce HyperBrowseComp, a multilingual and multimodal browsing benchmark comprising 423 manually authored and human-validated questions across 13 languages, written by native or highly proficient speakers. Questions are designed to be extremely challenging. Each question targets a concise, publicly verifiable answer whose discovery requires locating obscure evidence, following multi-step clue chains, or inspecting heterogeneous sources such as videos, scanned documents, images, or maps. Easier questions are filtered out by evaluating them with models without internet access to reduce the likelihood that they can be answered with parametric knowledge alone. We evaluate several models using provider-native search and a shared external retrieval harness under a common agent protocol. To contextualize model performance and effort, we also conduct a human evaluation on a sample of the questions. HyperBrowseComp provides a challenging testbed for persistent information seeking across languages and evidence modalities, with difficulty arising from discovering and connecting evidence on the open web.

ai_summary.problem: 现有网页浏览智能体评测多偏单语言、单模态且题目较容易，难以衡量其在真实开放网络上进行多语言、多模态、长链证据检索的能力。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 HyperBrowseComp，包含423道由母语者人工编写并验证的问题，覆盖13种语言，答案需通过查找冷门证据、追踪多步线索或检查视频、扫描文档、图像、地图等异构来源获得；并用无互联网模型过滤掉可凭参数知识直接回答的简单题。评测采用统一智能体协议，对比多个模型的提供商原生搜索与共享外部检索框架，并对部分问题进行了人类评估。
ai_summary.result: 该基准提供了极具挑战性的多语言、多模态持久信息检索测试平台；模型表现和投入程度被置于人类表现背景下比较，难度主要来自在开放网络上发现并连接证据。
ai_summary.novelty: 构建了跨13种语言、需多模态异构证据和多步线索推理的高难度人工验证浏览基准，并显式过滤参数知识可答问题。
ai_summary.relevance: 为评估和推动具备跨语言、多模态开放网络信息搜寻能力的网页浏览智能体提供了更严格、更贴近真实场景的测试标准。
ai_summary.org: 作者未在提供信息中标注机构；Alham Fikri Aji 可能与 MBZUAI 相关，但无法确认全部作者单位。

papers.title: ZeroMAG: Zero-Shot Multimodal Adapter Generation for Plug-and-Play EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract: EEG foundation models (EFMs) capture reusable knowledge from large-scale EEG data, while many EEG recordings also include companion physiological signals that provide complementary information beyond the EEG-only interface. The challenge is to preserve this pretrained knowledge while extending the EFM to heterogeneous multimodal recordings through an adaptation inferred from unlabeled target data. We introduce ZeroMAG, a zero-shot multimodal adapter generation framework that extends a frozen EEG encoder and prediction head using unlabeled target recordings, without target labels or target-side optimization. The target datasets are held out from all model training and selection in the ZeroMAG pipeline. ZeroMAG organizes companion modalities around a configuration-invariant adapter, constructs a modality-subject-task condition from unlabeled recordings and task context, and generates adapter weights in a function-constrained latent space learned from source adapters. Across six held-out target datasets and three EFM backbones, ZeroMAG improves balanced accuracy by 7.22 percentage points over EEG-only inference and 4.89 points over direct weight regression, while coming within 0.50 points of supervised multimodal adaptation on average. Ablations further show that removing functional supervision from either representation learning or conditional generation degrades generated-adapter performance, confirming the contribution of both components.

ai_summary.problem: 如何在保留预训练EEG基础模型知识的同时，仅利用无标签目标数据将其扩展到包含伴随生理信号的多模态记录中，且不做目标侧优化。
ai_summary.method: 提出ZeroMAG零样本多模态适配器生成框架：冻结EEG编码器和预测头，围绕配置不变的适配器组织伴随模态，从无标签记录与任务上下文中构建模态-被试-任务条件，并在从源适配器学到的函数约束隐空间中生成适配器权重。
ai_summary.result: 在6个留出目标数据集和3个EFM骨干上，ZeroMAG的平衡准确率比仅EEG推理高7.22个百分点，比直接权重回归高4.89个百分点，平均仅比有监督多模态适配低0.50个百分点；消融实验表明表示学习和条件生成中的功能监督均有贡献。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出零样本、无需目标标签和目标侧优化的多模态适配器生成框架，并通过函数约束隐空间生成适配器权重以支持异构伴随模态。
ai_summary.relevance: 为EEG等生理基础模型的即插即用、跨模态零样本适配提供新范式，也可启发其他基础模型的多模态适配器生成研究。

papers.title: UniDynamics: Event-RGB Fusion for Unified Future 4D Dynamic Scene Generation
papers.abstract: We propose UniDynamics, a diffusion-based framework for future 4D dynamic scenes (RGB, depth, and optical flow) generation from a single event-RGB pair, without requiring long histories or control priors as in existing methods, while explicitly modeling future motion fields. The core idea is to leverage event streams to offer an alternative motion prior for single-RGB extrapolation, and to enforce geometric and motion constraints throughout generation via multimodal modeling. Specifically, we design an Event Latent Enhancement (ELE) module to align and enhance event latents into diffusion-injectable conditioning features, providing robust initial motion priors and reliable texture/structure cues. We further introduce a Perceptual Dynamics Space (PDS) embedded in the multi-scale U-Net, which decouples and adaptively interacts depth and flow while continuously feeding back constraints to appearance features, improving geometric-motion consistency for physically plausible and spatiotemporally coherent prediction. Experiments on VKitti2 and DSEC demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, producing high-quality, temporally coherent, and 4D-consistent future predictions, especially under challenging high-speed motion blur.

ai_summary.problem: 如何仅凭单帧事件-RGB对，在无需长历史序列或控制先验的情况下，生成未来4D动态场景（RGB、深度、光流），并显式建模未来运动场。
ai_summary.method: 提出基于扩散模型的UniDynamics框架，利用事件流为单帧RGB外推提供运动先验，并通过多模态建模施加几何与运动约束。设计Event Latent Enhancement模块将事件潜变量对齐增强为可注入扩散模型的条件特征，并引入嵌入多尺度U-Net的Perceptual Dynamics Space，解耦并自适应交互深度与光流，持续反馈约束外观特征。
ai_summary.result: 在VKitti2和DSEC数据集上取得最先进性能，能生成高质量、时间连贯且4D一致的未来预测，尤其在高速度运动模糊等挑战场景下表现良好。
ai_summary.novelty: 将事件流作为单帧RGB未来外推的运动先验，并通过ELE与PDS在扩散框架中统一建模RGB、深度和光流的未来4D动态场景。
ai_summary.relevance: 对世界模型、多模态感知和具身智能中的动态场景预测与物理一致性建模具有参考价值。
ai_summary.org: 未能从提供信息中识别（作者机构未给出）

papers.title: A Vision-Language Model (VLM)-based Pipeline for End-to-End Procedural Modeling of Field-Grown Maize from Point Clouds
papers.abstract: Editable 3D models of field-grown crops support high-throughput phenotyping and in silico breeding trials, but building them from scanned point clouds requires organ-level segmentation and fitting. Procedural generators can turn an organ-level parameter set into an analysis-suitable 3D model, but obtaining that set requires hours of manual tuning per plant or segmentation models trained on species-specific labels. We present an automated pipeline that reconstructs procedural maize models from raw 3D point clouds without manual tuning or species-specific training data. A multimodal vision-language model (VLM) annotates leaf midlines in rendered orthographic views. Deterministic geometric algorithms back-project the annotations onto the point cloud, merge them into 3D leaves by cross-view consensus, and grow the midlines to full blades on an orientation-weighted surface graph. Measured organ parameters populate a plant descriptor for a Non-Uniform Rational B-Spline (NURBS)-based procedural model generator. Each leaf surface is then refined against its scan points by differentiable NURBS fitting. The pipeline reached a median whole-plant Chamfer distance of 5.4 mm on 100 genotypically diverse field-grown maize plants from the MaizeField3D dataset. The reconstructions were closer to the scans than those of an earlier semi-automated pipeline based on manual annotations. The pipeline recovered 1,017 of 1,023 (99.4%) curated reference leaves at an intersection-over-union of at least 0.5 without using those labels as input. These results show that VLM annotations become usable organ-level measurements when downstream geometric stages can correct them. This makes automated generation of editable 3D plant assets feasible at the scale of modern phenotyping experiments.

ai_summary.problem: 如何从田间玉米的原始3D点云中自动重建可编辑的程序化3D植株模型，避免人工逐株调参和依赖物种特异性标注训练数据。
ai_summary.method: 用多模态视觉语言模型（VLM）在正交渲染视图中标注叶片中线，再通过确定性几何算法将标注反投影到点云、跨视图共识合并成3D叶片，并在方向加权表面图上生长出完整叶面；随后测量器官参数填入植株描述符，驱动基于NURBS的程序化模型生成器，并用可微NURBS拟合对每片叶面进行扫描点精修。
ai_summary.result: 在MaizeField3D数据集的100株基因型多样田间玉米上，整株Chamfer距离中位数为5.4 mm，优于此前基于人工标注的半自动流程；在不使用参考标签作为输入的情况下，以IoU≥0.5恢复了1023片参考叶中的1017片（99.4%）。
ai_summary.novelty: 证明VLM的粗标注经下游几何阶段校正后，可转化为可用的器官级测量，从而实现无需人工调参和物种特异性训练数据的端到端程序化植株建模。

papers.title: When Is Accuracy Evidence? A Unified Theory of Generalisation, Validation, and Information Fusion
papers.abstract: K-fold cross-validation (CV) is widely used as evidence of out-of-sample performance, although folds are neither independent experiments nor equally informative under heterogeneous data. Cross Upper-Bound Validation (CUBV) replaces point-wise CV accuracy by conservative upper bounds on true risk. Here we generalise CUBV through a single exponential framework in which the moment-generating function of the generalisation gap is controlled by a cumulant envelope gamma(lambda). This yields a family of risk bounds covering Hoeffding-, Bernstein-, dependency-aware, PAC-Bayesian, and heterogeneous source-fusion settings. For K-fold CV, dependence between fold-wise gaps is modelled through a joint sub-Gaussian proxy matrix. Under equicorrelation, this gives an effective number of folds, Keff = K/[1+(K-1)rho], showing that increasing K does not necessarily increase statistical evidence when folds are strongly dependent. The framework is also extended to posterior distributions over predictors and weighted multi-source fusion, where weights are selected by minimising an upper bound on future risk rather than empirical error alone. Experiments with trained linear classifiers on heterogeneous multimodal Gaussian mixtures compare K-fold CV with full-sample resubstitution plus risk correction. Bounds are evaluated by coverage and tightness. In low-dimensional small-sample settings, K-fold partitioning can increase uncertainty because individual folds under-represent minority modes, while corrected resubstitution can remain valid and tighter; this effect disappears as sample size increases. Overall, gamma-CUBV separates observed performance, uncertainty, dependence, model complexity, and confidence into explicit terms, providing a unified route from CV scores to risk statements and a principled validation criterion for heterogeneous small-sample applications such as neuroimaging.

ai_summary.problem: K-fold 交叉验证常被当作样本外性能证据，但在异质数据下各折既不独立也不等信息量，缺乏统一的风险保证。论文旨在为验证、泛化和信息融合建立统一理论。
ai_summary.method: 提出 gamma-CUBV 统一指数框架，用泛化间隙矩母函数的累积量包络 gamma(lambda) 控制风险上界，覆盖 Hoeffding、Bernstein、依赖感知、PAC-Bayes 和多源融合等情形。对 K-fold CV，用联合 sub-Gaussian 代理矩阵建模折间依赖，并在等相关下给出有效折数 Keff = K/[1+(K-1)rho]，同时扩展到后验预测分布和加权多源融合。
ai_summary.result: 在异质多模态高斯混合上的线性分类器实验中，低维小样本下 K-fold 划分可能因单折欠代表少数模态而增加不确定性，修正的重代入法反而可能更紧且有效；样本量增大后该效应消失。框架将观测性能、不确定性、依赖、模型复杂度和置信度显式分离。
ai_summary.novelty: 将 CUBV 推广为统一的 gamma 累积量风险上界理论，并把折间依赖、PAC-Bayes、多源融合和有效折数纳入同一验证框架。
ai_summary.relevance: 为把交叉验证分数转化为可靠风险声明提供原则性准则，对异质小样本 AI 验证（如神经影像）有方法学指导意义。

papers.title: Measure Less, Know More: Self-Supervised Test-Time Feature Acquisition
papers.abstract: Recent progress in multimodal, high-dimensional learning has enabled foundation models to process heterogeneous, large-scale data. However, at test time, acquiring all features or modalities can be prohibitively costly and often redundant. Sequentially selecting informative modalities is therefore critical, yet challenging when the downstream task or prediction target is unknown. To this end, we introduce ECHO-$k$, a task-agnostic and self-supervised learning principle for modality acquisition: we use a deep model's internal pretrained representations (e.g., from a foundation model) as proxy targets that summarize cross-modal information. We provide theoretical guarantees in a stylized linear setting that motivate a reinforcement learning (RL) policy for sequential modality selection. Across task-agnostic and label-free acquisition baselines, ECHO-$k$ consistently improves budgeted downstream performance across diverse foundation-model backends. Our method provides a principled route to cost-aware test-time deployment, with implications for any multimodal system where measurements are expensive or time-constrained, and downstream tasks unknown a priori.

ai_summary.problem: 测试时获取全部特征或模态往往代价高昂且存在冗余，而在下游任务和预测目标未知时，顺序选择信息量最大的模态非常困难。
ai_summary.method: 提出 ECHO-k，一种任务无关、自监督的模态获取原则：利用深度模型（如基础模型）内部预训练表示作为代理目标，以汇总跨模态信息；并在线性设定下给出理论保证，进而用强化学习策略进行顺序模态选择。
ai_summary.result: 在任务无关且无标签的获取基线中，ECHO-k 在不同基础模型后端上均能持续提升有限预算下的下游性能。
ai_summary.novelty: 将基础模型内部表示作为自监督代理目标，并结合理论分析与强化学习实现任务无关的顺序模态获取。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态系统在测量昂贵、时间受限且下游任务未知时的成本感知测试时部署提供了原则性路径。

papers.title: Corrupted but Correct: Why Vision-Language Models Lie to Themselves Internally
papers.abstract: A targeted adversarial perturbation can drive a vision-language model's (VLM's) teacher-forced training loss for a fixed target caption to near zero, yet the same model, allowed to generate freely, produces the original, correct description with no trace of the target. We call this dissociation the train/inference gap, and give it a precise mechanistic account on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct using a controlled two-stage PGD attack on 200 held-out COCO images. First, we show that image-level pixel statistics, including a correctly re-implemented, texture-based attackability measure from the CNN robustness literature, have essentially no predictive power over which images are corrupted (best predictor r=-0.050, p=0.484; ridge regression R^2=0.069). Second, using the logit lens, we localise the gap to a single autoregressive step: the rank of the target token, conditioned on the correct first token already being generated, is fixed at exactly 3,488 out of 152,064 vocabulary entries for every image and every condition, with zero variance. Third, tracking target-token rank across all 28 LLM decoder layers reveals that the visual encoder corrupts every image's representation by a comparable margin regardless of eventual outcome, but the language model decoder then differentially arbitrates: amplifying the corrupted signal for susceptible images and actively suppressing it, past its clean-image baseline, for resistant ones (p<0.001, rank-biserial r=0.579). A linear probe on the merger hidden state separates these two outcomes with AUC=0.858, though we flag a circularity concern in this estimate. Together these results argue that adversarial robustness in autoregressive VLMs is substantially a property of the language decoder's prior, not the visual encoder, with direct implications for where faithfulness evaluations and defenses for deployed VLM systems should be targeted.

ai_summary.problem: 论文研究视觉语言模型在对抗扰动下出现的一种反常现象：teacher-forcing训练损失可被压到接近零，但模型自由生成时仍输出正确描述，即“训练/推理差距”，并试图给出精确机制解释。
ai_summary.method: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct上，对200张COCO图像实施受控两阶段PGD攻击；结合图像像素统计、logit lens、逐层目标token rank追踪和线性探针，分析视觉编码器与语言解码器在差距形成中的作用。
ai_summary.result: 发现差距可定位到单个自回归步骤：在已生成正确首token条件下，目标token rank恒为3488/152064且零方差；视觉编码器对所有图像造成相近污染，语言解码器则差异化仲裁——易感图像放大污染信号，抵抗图像主动抑制污染信号，线性探针区分两类结果的AUC=0.858。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将自回归VLM的对抗鲁棒性主要归因于语言解码器先验而非视觉编码器，并给出单步rank机制证据。
ai_summary.relevance: 为VLM忠实性评估和对抗防御应重点针对语言解码器而非仅视觉编码器提供了直接启示。

papers.title: CLIMB: Confidence-Guided Complementary Evidence for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong visual reasoning abilities, but knowledge-intensive visual question answering often requires external textual evidence beyond the image and the model's parametric knowledge. Existing multimodal RAG systems commonly rely on Top-$K$ retrieval or reranking, which may return redundant passages and provide limited control over whether an answer update is sufficiently supported by the retrieved evidence. We propose \textit{CLIMB}, a training-free inference-time framework for multimodal RAG. CLIMB first constructs a compact complementary evidence pool using an MMR-style objective that balances query relevance and passage-level redundancy. It then performs confidence-controlled refinement within this fixed pool: an R/E/C critic scores passages by relevance, evidence specificity, and cross-modal alignment, while an evidence-grounded confidence estimator accepts an updated answer only when the estimated confidence increases. This design provides a simple stopping criterion and reduces unnecessary refinement without modifying the underlying retriever or MLLM. Experiments on Encyclopedic-VQA and InfoSeek show that CLIMB consistently improves over retrieval-augmented multimodal baselines. Ablations further indicate that complementary pooling, critic-based scoring, and iterative confidence-controlled refinement each contribute to the final performance.

ai_summary.problem: 知识密集型视觉问答中，现有多模态RAG系统常依赖Top-K检索或重排序，可能返回冗余段落，且对答案更新是否被检索证据充分支持缺乏控制。
ai_summary.method: 提出免训练的推理时框架CLIMB：先用MMR式目标构建兼顾查询相关性与段落冗余度的紧凑互补证据池；再在固定池内进行置信度控制的迭代精炼，利用R/E/C评论器从相关性、证据特异性和跨模态对齐打分，并由证据接地置信度估计器仅在置信度提升时接受更新答案。
ai_summary.result: 在Encyclopedic-VQA和InfoSeek上，CLIMB持续优于检索增强的多模态基线；消融实验表明互补证据池、评论器打分和迭代置信度控制精炼均有贡献。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新在于免训练、置信度引导的互补证据选择与精炼机制，为多模态RAG提供简单停止准则并减少无效精炼。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作提升了多模态RAG的证据利用效率与答案可靠性，且无需修改检索器或MLLM，对知识密集型视觉问答系统有实用意义。

papers.title: SCAD: Structured Credit Assignment and Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract: Training long-horizon agents to solve complex tasks requires effective supervision over extended interaction sequences. However, sparse terminal rewards obscure intermediate contributions, while on-policy distillation can lose informative teacher guidance as student-generated histories grow. To address this problem, we introduce SCAD, which organizes interactions into planning and bounded subtask execution, distills execution in local contexts, and refines planning credit through cross-rollout subtask prefix trees, with planning receiving full terminal credit and execution receiving positive terminal credit and teacher guidance. Across all evaluated benchmarks, SCAD improves macro-average accuracy over the strongest training baseline by 4.48 percentage points for text tasks and 4.19 points for multimodal tasks. SCAD effectively combines outcome-based credit assignment with teacher-guided distillation to improve planning and execution in long-horizon agents.

ai_summary.problem: 训练长时程智能体时，稀疏终端奖励难以区分中间步骤的贡献；同时 on-policy 蒸馏会随学生生成历史变长而丢失教师的有效指导。
ai_summary.method: SCAD 将交互组织为规划与有界子任务执行：在局部上下文中蒸馏执行过程，并通过跨 rollout 的子任务前缀树细化规划信用分配。规划获得完整终端信用，执行获得正向终端信用和教师指导。
ai_summary.result: 在文本任务上，SCAD 比最强训练基线提升 4.48 个百分点的宏平均准确率；在多模态任务上提升 4.19 个百分点，有效结合了结果信用分配与教师引导蒸馏。
ai_summary.novelty: 将结构化信用分配（跨 rollout 子任务前缀树）与局部上下文 on-policy 蒸馏结合，分别优化长时程规划与子任务执行。
ai_summary.relevance: 为长时程 Agent 的稀疏奖励训练与蒸馏提供了新框架，有助于提升复杂多步任务中的规划与执行能力。

papers.title: What Should World Models Forget? Stratified Retention for Continual Adaptation
papers.abstract: Continual learning treats degradation on previously seen data as evidence of failure, a convention inherited from settings with a stationary prediction target, where a correct label remains correct indefinitely. World models do not satisfy this condition. Their prediction target is the environment, which changes, so knowledge that was accurate when acquired may later become false, and discarding it is required behavior rather than a defect. Non-stationary ground truth is well studied in the concept drift literature and in the temporal factuality of language models, but has not been formulated for world models, which are distinctive in that they also encode knowledge that must never be revised. We argue that continual world models require retention stratified by invariance timescale, separating invariants such as physics and object permanence, which must never be revised, from instance-level facts that should be revised as soon as the environment changes. Standard forgetting metrics cannot distinguish a world model that has correctly revised outdated knowledge from one that has suffered catastrophic forgetting, and consequently rank a frozen model highest, while existing physical-reasoning benchmarks evaluate only frozen checkpoints. We propose differential retention, which reports invariant regression testing across the adaptation stream jointly with revision latency, without aggregation.

ai_summary.problem: 持续学习（continual learning）沿用了平稳预测目标的假设，把对旧数据的性能下降一律视为灾难性遗忘；但世界模型的预测目标（环境）本身会变化，过时知识必须被修正，因此需要区分「应当忘记」与「不应忘记」的知识。
ai_summary.method: 提出按「不变性时间尺度」分层的保留策略（stratified retention）：把物理规律、客体永久性等永不修改的不变量，与随环境变化应立即修正的实例级事实分开处理；并设计 differential retention 评估协议，在适应流上同时报告不变量回归测试与修正延迟（revision latency），不做单一聚合。
ai_summary.result: 论文论证指出标准遗忘指标无法区分「正确修正过时知识」与「灾难性遗忘」，会错误地把冻结模型排为最优，而现有物理推理基准也只评测冻结检查点；因此主张用分层、非聚合的指标替代传统遗忘度量，但摘要未给出实验验证。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将「非平稳真值」问题形式化到世界模型场景，并提出按不变性时间尺度分层保留与不变性回归+修正延迟的联合评测框架。
ai_summary.relevance: 为持续学习/世界模型研究提供了新的问题定义与评测范式，提示不能再用静态基准和单一遗忘指标衡量具备环境适应能力的世界模型。

papers.title: Beyond Entropy: Self-Diagnostic Multi-Role Token Optimization for Video Reasoning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has substantially advanced multimodal reasoning, yet it remains fundamentally limited by ambiguous token-level credit assignment. While high-entropy token heuristics encourage possibility exploration, naively extending them to video reasoning tends to induce lengthy reasoning, as the model becomes overly reliant on high-entropy visual activations. Alternative approaches that rely on counterfactual-based visual token localization for credit assignment also tend to over-prioritize visual exploration at the expense of decisive reasoning cues for answer derivation, thereby exacerbating the interference from spurious visual nuances. Moreover, these methods employ static counterfactual strategies that fail to co-evolve with the policy during training. In this paper, we introduce DyCPO, a co-evolutionary framework that jointly optimizes reliable token selection and adaptive counterfactual intervention. It constructs a multi-role dependence metric to balance visual exploration and answer-relevance mining in token-wise contrastive learning, while suppressing exploration-only filler tokens and spurious visual noise. Rather than relying on static counterfactual priors, DyCPO dynamically derives counterfactual signals from the model's own successful and failed rollouts, enabling self-diagnostic analysis and co-evolution of the optimization objective with the policy. Extensive experiments on complex video reasoning and general video understanding benchmarks demonstrate consistent performance improvements, establishing DyCPO as a robust token-level credit assignment paradigm for multimodal reinforcement learning.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态强化学习中的 token 级信用分配存在歧义：高熵 token 启发式会导致冗长推理，而反事实视觉 token 定位方法又过度偏向视觉探索、忽视决定性推理线索，且采用静态反事实策略，无法随策略训练共同演化。
ai_summary.method: 提出 DyCPO 共演化框架，联合优化可靠 token 选择与自适应反事实干预：构建多角色依赖度量，在 token 级对比学习中平衡视觉探索与答案相关性挖掘，抑制纯探索性的填充 token 与虚假视觉噪声；反事实信号不再依赖静态先验，而是从模型自身成功/失败 rollout 中动态导出，实现自诊断分析与优化目标随策略的共演化。
ai_summary.result: 在复杂视频推理与通用视频理解基准上均取得一致的性能提升，验证了 DyCPO 作为多模态强化学习中稳健的 token 级信用分配范式的有效性。
ai_summary.novelty: 用模型自身成功/失败轨迹动态生成反事实信号，构建多角色依赖度量以在 token 级同时平衡视觉探索与答案相关性，实现优化目标与策略的共演化。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型（尤其是视频推理）的强化学习提供了更可靠的细粒度信用分配思路，有助于提升推理效率与准确性，抑制冗长推理和视觉噪声干扰。

papers.title: EVEWorld: Physical Evolution Supervision for Embodied World Models
papers.abstract: Embodied world models enable scalable simulation of embodied interactions for robot learning. However, existing models are prone to Model Laziness, as they focus on visual fidelity at the expense of physical reasoning and lack process-level supervision over the temporal dynamics of manipulated objects. In this work, we propose EVEWorld, a physical evolution-supervision framework for physically consistent target evolution. EVEWorld consists of two components: Instance-Guided Restoration (IGR) and Temporal Instance Alignment (TIA). First, IGR promotes instance consistency through restoration supervision. Second, TIA promotes cross-frame consistency by aligning target instances across adjacent frames. We further introduce the Model Laziness Rate (MLR), a metric that measures persistent violations of instance consistency in generated trajectories. Extensive experiments on DreamGenBench, EWMBench, and PBench demonstrate the effectiveness of EVEWorld, notably achieving an 87.5% reduction in MLR compared with GigaWorld-0. On the WorldArena 2.0 Track 1 leaderboard, our model ranks 6th in JEPA Similarity and 17th overall, which further validates the performance of our evolution supervision strategy.

ai_summary.problem: 现有具身世界模型存在“模型懒惰”问题：过度追求视觉逼真度而忽视物理推理，且缺乏对被操作物体时序动态的过程级监督，导致生成轨迹中目标实例持续不一致。
ai_summary.method: 提出 EVEWorld 物理演化监督框架，包含实例引导修复（IGR）和时序实例对齐（TIA）两个组件：IGR 通过修复监督提升实例一致性，TIA 通过对齐相邻帧中的目标实例提升跨帧一致性；同时提出模型懒惰率（MLR）指标来量化生成轨迹中实例一致性的持续违背。
ai_summary.result: 在 DreamGenBench、EWMBench 和 PBench 上验证了有效性，相比 GigaWorld-0 将 MLR 降低 87.5%；在 WorldArena 2.0 Track 1 榜单上 JEPA Similarity 排名第 6、总排名第 17。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次从过程级物理演化监督角度切入，用实例引导修复与时序实例对齐双重监督抑制世界模型的“懒惰”行为，并提出了可量化的 MLR 评价指标。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身世界模型提供了以物理一致性为核心的监督范式与评价标准，有助于提升机器人学习中仿真数据的物理可信度与可扩展性。

papers.title: Transcriptome-informed multi-modal AI for predicting neoadjuvant therapy response from breast cancer biopsies
papers.abstract: Scarcity of labeled data limits development of deep learning biomarkers in oncology. We develop a two-stage AI model predicting pathological complete response (pCR) to neoadjuvant therapy in breast cancer. The first stage learns the transcriptome from histopathology using 8,742 patients across 32 cancer types, corroborated by pathologist review and spatial agreement with measured expression. This simplifies the second stage to predicting pCR from inferred expression and clinical variables. Developed using 1,080 patients (five cohorts) and evaluated in 1,412 patients (nine cohorts), the model achieves a pooled AUROC of 0.79 (95% CI, 0.73-0.85), discriminating responders within molecular subtypes. It outperforms histopathological biomarkers, remaining stable across intratumoral sampling and with minimal biopsy tissue. Ablations show transcriptome-wide inference improves discrimination over clinical variables alone or one-stage pathology models, and robustness by avoiding genomic assays' gene selection constraints. These results indicate that biologically informed compression may generalize to data-sparse applications in precision oncology.

papers.title: Detect and Suppress: A Mechanistic Defense against Adversarial Patches in VLA Models
papers.abstract: Adversarial patches can disrupt Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by manipulating visual observations, leading to failures in robot control. However, it remains poorly understood which internal mechanisms underlie these failures and how targeted interventions can mitigate them. In this work, we mechanistically analyze VLA representations using a sparse autoencoder (SAE) and identify a feature whose activation strongly correlates with the presence of an adversarial patch. Based on this analysis, we suppress the identified feature at inference time only when a linear probe detects an attack. This intervention improves robustness without the cost of fine-tuning the VLA. We evaluate our method against VLA adversarial patch attacks on LIBERO-10. Conditional intervention improves success rate under intermittent attacks, whereas continuously applying the same intervention substantially degrades policy performance. These results show that attack-related internal representations can provide useful targets for VLA adversarial defense and that controlling when to intervene is important for limiting disruption to nominal policy behavior.

papers.title: From Patching to Pruning Visual Computation in Vision Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision language models (VLMs) incur substantial inference cost because every visual token is processed by the attention and MLP projections of every decoder layer, even when token-specific visual computation is unnecessary at many depths. We introduce Patch-to-Prune (P2P), inspired by Mechanistic Interpretability, a training-free framework that converts activation patching from a diagnostic tool into an inference-time computation bypass. P2P performs validation-guided forward and backward layer sweeps to identify decoder regions whose visual-token projection outputs can be replaced by fixed neutral proxy activation vectors within a user-specified accuracy tolerance. Unlike conventional token-pruning methods, P2P preserves the sequence length, token order, positional information, attention mask, and residual pathways, thereby pruning computation without removing tokens or modifying the pretrained model weights. We evaluate P2P on four VLMs from the Qwen2.5-VL and LLaVA families across seven multi-modal benchmarks using mutually disjoint calibration, validation, and test partitions. P2P at a 3% tolerance retains around 94% of dense accuracy while reducing FLOPs by 55%. Beyond these efficiency gains, our layer-wise analysis suggests that visual processing in VLMs is non-uniformly distributed across decoder depth: early and late layers often require little token-specific visual computation, whereas intermediate layers appear to perform most task-relevant visual integration, enabling later reasoning to rely largely on visual information already embedded in shared residual and textual representations. This makes P2P both an efficient inference framework and a causal lens into visual information processing in VLMs.
